records.exactSourceText: Own its domain, stores and adapters
records.materialMeaning: Ghatana Media owns its media domain semantics, projects and assets, domain stores and adapters, processing intent and job state, timeline and animation/simulation presentation, quality, rights, and delivery intent. Media consumes admitted Ghatana Shared, Tools, and platform generic contracts through explicit Media-owned ports; Media is a product consumer, not a generic platform owner. This definition does not assert store or adapter implementation or runtime admission.

records.exactSourceText: Regenerate affected projections and rerun affected checks only.
records.materialMeaning: Regenerate only projections and checks in the changed dependency closure; preserve unaffected source versions and approvals. A material output change requires its affected approval to be regenerated.

records.exactSourceText: It is a distinct admitted capability bundle, not a generic multimodal rewrite |
records.materialMeaning: Controlled generation is a distinct, explicitly admitted capability bundle with its own scope and contracts; generic multimodal inference is not a substitute.

records.exactSourceText: Rendering success, package validity, successful transport, and public publication are separate outcomes.
records.materialMeaning: Rendering, package validity, transport, and publication have separate typed outcome dispositions. Each axis may be SUCCEEDED, FAILED, UNKNOWN, or NOT_APPLICABLE with the corresponding exact evidence or reason; no axis implies another axis succeeded. A truthful partial result need not claim all four axes were observed.

records.exactSourceText: supported interchange subset |
records.materialMeaning: Export requires a named supported interchange subset; unsupported extensions or lossless interchange assumptions block export or require an explicit loss report.

records.exactSourceText: Batch requests use a bounded execution group with a stable group ID and per-item semantic keys, budgets and job/output references.
records.materialMeaning: A batch has one stable group ID and per-item semantic key, budget, operation/job identity, and output reference; item identity and budget cannot be replaced by group-level defaults.

records.exactSourceText: a partial group reports each item’s outcome and cannot masquerade as complete.
records.materialMeaning: Report terminal, partial, or unknown disposition for every item. The aggregate is complete only when every required item has a terminal successful result and output reference.

records.exactSourceText: Render/master/encode/export/publish as typed jobs/effects
records.materialMeaning: Represent render, master, encode, export, and publish as distinct typed jobs/effects with ordered dependencies and their own finality; no stage is inferred from the next stage name.

records.exactSourceText: `--output` is a client download destination
records.materialMeaning: The CLI `--output` value is a client-side download destination used after an authorized output read; it is never a server path, server write, or route.

records.exactSourceText: Non-interactive consequential commands must receive explicit approval/policy input and fail rather than block for a prompt.
records.materialMeaning: A consequential noninteractive command requires explicit approval and policy inputs. If either is absent or unresolved, it fails closed without prompting or selecting a default.

records.exactSourceText: cancellation ability and external provider retention remain truthful.
records.materialMeaning: Cancellation capability and provider-side retention are separate scoped dispositions. Each may be observed, explicitly unknown, or not applicable; do not require evidence for an axis that was not established. A cancellation request or acknowledgment does not prove provider stop, deletion, or retention.

records.exactSourceText: Encryption, key deletion and provider deletion claims need the deployment-specific proof they assert.
records.materialMeaning: Report only the requested security or deletion outcome axes, each with deployment-bound evidence or an explicit UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE disposition. Encryption, key deletion, and provider-side deletion are independent; evidence for one cannot substitute for another, and unrequested axes need not be asserted.

records.exactSourceText: Profile/model fallback must pass policy/rights/cost/quality eligibility again.
records.materialMeaning: Any fallback rechecks current profile, model policy, rights, cost, quality, and locality eligibility for the fallback candidate; failed or unknown checks block dispatch.

records.exactSourceText: do not advertise “exactly once” remote inference without a provider contract proving it.
records.materialMeaning: Do not claim exactly-once remote inference without an exact provider contract proving durable idempotency across dispatch and reconciliation. Track effect outcome independently: a known success or failure remains reportable without an exactly-once guarantee, while an unknown dispatch outcome is not automatically retried.

records.exactSourceText: Local/private operation can use deterministic engines and an admitted local inference deployment while preserving AI Inference ownership.
records.materialMeaning: Local/private workflows may use deterministic engines or separately admitted local inference while AI Inference remains the owner of inference-domain meaning and policy. Locality is not admission.

records.exactSourceText: It cannot claim fresh remote revocation checks while disconnected.
records.materialMeaning: While disconnected, the client cannot claim a fresh remote revocation check. The cache may be absent, stale, unknown, or current for an exact scope and freshness window; only a matching current cache can support the bounded cached-authority claim, and consequential work is held otherwise.

records.exactSourceText: Review comments bind to artifact version and time/region, not a moving “latest” frame.
records.materialMeaning: A review comment is anchored to an immutable artifact version plus exact time/region coordinates; “latest” is not a stable review subject.

records.exactSourceText: Approvals bind exact output/version, review purpose, approver authority and expiry.
records.materialMeaning: An approval binds the exact output and version, review purpose, approver authority, scope, and expiry; any tuple change invalidates the approval.

records.exactSourceText: Shared review links have explicit scope, expiry and revocation
records.materialMeaning: A shared review link has explicit recipient/resource scope, expiry, and revocation state; absent or unknown scope/currentness prevents access.

records.exactSourceText: keyboard selection/trim/reorder and non-drag alternatives
records.materialMeaning: Keyboard users can select, trim, and reorder using equivalent non-drag operations with visible focus and announced resulting order; pointer drag is not the sole path.

records.exactSourceText: use a bounded public integration
records.materialMeaning: A public integration exposes only bounded, named Media actions through a public contract with closed typed input/output, host-established authority, and finite resource limits.

records.exactSourceText: No recursive budget reset or self-authorizing tool call |
records.materialMeaning: Delegation budgets are monotonic and cannot be recursively reset. A tool result cannot authorize itself or expand its own capability/authority.

records.exactSourceText: Pilot recipes preserve breadth while limiting initial implementation cost: uploaded interview cleanup/captions
records.materialMeaning: The pilot recipe begins with uploaded interview cleanup and captions, retaining the wider product breadth while bounding initial cost and requiring preservation, comparison, and review of exact outputs.
